name: Savio Water Master Solids Pump - Water Master Solids 2050
description: Manufacturer's DescriptionSavio Water Master Solids Handling Pumps are our top-of-the-line model for professional use. These pumps can handle suspended debris and spherical solids up to 1 1/4" and 1 1/2" in diameter for the 5000 and 6500. Oil-less design makes them safe for use in environments with fish, plants and other aquatic life. Perfect for continuous duty use in Skimmerfilters and pond filtration systems.
